observed_mechanics: 0x0096ff70 is 8 bytes: SUB ECX,0x0C (83 E9 0C) then JMP 0x0096FFD0 (E9 58 00 00 00); 0x0096ff78..0x0096ff7f is INT3 padding.
The function is a pure adjustor thunk: it writes only ECX, reads no stack slot, consults no flag, and has no branch other than the unconditional tail JMP.

The sole reference to 0x0096ff70 in the entire image is a DATA pointer at 0x0144258c, which is byte offset +0x08 of the pointer run based at 0x01442584 (Ghidra long run, namespace UTFWin, firstSlotFunc FUN_00e246c0).
There is no code caller; the call graph is a single-node SCC (scc-0059) whose only edge is the outgoing JMP, matching a vtable-resident leaf.

Tail target 0x0096FFD0 spans 0x0096ffd0..0x00970008 and is the shared deleting destructor of the family: it stores 0x014425D8 to [this+0x00], 0x014425C0 to [this+0x04], 0x01442584 to [this+0x0C] and 0x013EB938 to [this+0x60], calls 0x00980420, calls 0x00951330(this) only when bit 0 of the stack flag is set, then MOV EAX,ESI / POP ESI / RET 0x4.

Those four written words are exactly four of the slots the ModAPI SDK documents for UTFWin::GlideEffect (SIZE 0x70): BiStateEffect vptr +0x00, ILayoutElement vptr +0x04, IBiStateEffect vptr +0x0C, IGlideEffect vptr +0x60, with mnRefCount at +0x08 and mOffset at +0x64.

Because the tail target's receiver is the most-derived object and the thunk subtracts 0x0C, the vptr this thunk was reached through must sit on the subobject at +0x0C, which the SDK places as GlideEffect's IBiStateEffect subobject.

Sibling thunks in the same leaf block share the shape: 0x0096FF80 is SUB ECX,0x04 / JMP 0x0096FFD0 and 0x0096FF90 is SUB ECX,0x0C / JMP 0x0096FF20; 0x0096FF20 tests the 0xEF2B293B vector-delete magic and ends in RET 0x4, so 0x0096FFD0 / 0x0096FF20 are the scalar- and vector-deleting pair and 0x0096FF70 / 0x0096FF90 are their GlideEffect-side thunks.

The already-reconstructed sibling UTFWin::InflateEffect::func88h at 0x0097e550 is byte-for-byte the same two-instruction form (SUB ECX,0xC / JMP 0x0097E4A0) and is modelled in reconstruction/staging/pkg-utfwin-effects-wave6 as receiver minus 0x0c followed by a tail call, which this reconstruction follows.
